title: Yzesty Irish Serrano Ham Pasta
description: This salty post-workout dish features a combination of serrano ham and ttukbaegi in a glassy-jelly pasta sauce.

ingredients.name: ttukbaegi
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for at least an hour, drained and chopped finely

instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add sliced serrano ham and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same pan, add chopped ttukbaegi and red pepper flakes. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until fragrant.
Return serrano ham to the pan with ttukbaegi mixture and stir well.
Stir in salt and black pepper to taste. Simmer for another minute.
Bring a pot of salted water to boil. Add pasta, cook according to package instructions.
Drain pasta, then toss it into the serrano ham-ttukbaegi sauce.
